variants.advanced: Create responsive masonry layout. Implementation options: CSS columns (simple), CSS Grid with grid-row span (more control), or JS library (masonry-layout, react-masonry-css) for complex cases. Column count: responsive breakpoints (2 on mobile, 3 on tablet, 4+ on desktop). Gap: consistent spacing between items. Item sizing: items have natural/intrinsic height, images maintain aspect ratio. Lazy loading: images load as they scroll into view, skeleton placeholder. Loading new items: append to grid, animate entrance. Filtering: show/hide items by category with re-layout animation. Infinite scroll: load more items, integrate with scroll detection. Click interaction: open lightbox for images, or modal for detailed view. Hover effects: overlay with actions (save, share, view), slight zoom. Card content: image, title, description, author avatar, stats (likes, comments). Responsive images: srcset for different sizes, optimize for column width. Accessibility: grid landmark, proper image alt text, keyboard navigation. Performance: virtualize if hundreds of items, use content-visibility for off-screen items. Image error handling: fallback image or placeholder.
